text: きみは　すてみで　この　チャンピオンロードを　ぬけて　きたのだな！

structure.en: by putting everything on the line

structure.jp: この　チャンピオンロードを
ぬけて　きたのだな！

patterns.name: 〜てくる
patterns.explanation: くる after a て-form says the action was done on the way to where the speaker is. ぬけて　きた = 'came through (to here)'.

patterns.name: 〜のだ
patterns.explanation: のだ at the end shows the speaker has worked something out and is saying 'so that's how it is'; な adds 'right?'. きたのだな = 'so you've come, haven't you'.

patterns.name: 〜で (how)
patterns.explanation: で here tells the way something is done. すてみで = 'by risking everything'.
